runner:
runners_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${COMPI_RUNNERS_FILE}")" && pwd) module_dir="${runners_dir}/generic-env-runner"
if [ -f "${module_dir}/conda-envs.env" ]; then . "${module_dir}/conda-envs.env" fi if [ -f "${module_dir}/docker.env" ]; then . "${module_dir}/docker.env" fi
task_key="${task_id//[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/_}" conda_env_var="${task_key}_conda_env" docker_image_var="${task_key}_image" conda_env="${!conda_env_var}" docker_image="${!docker_image_var}"
if [ -n "${conda_env}" ] && [ -n "${docker_image}" ]; then echo "[runner] ERROR: task '${task_id}' has both conda and docker configured." >&2 exit 1 fi
if [ -n "${conda_env}" ]; then /bin/bash "${module_dir}/runner_conda.sh" "${conda_env}" "${task_code}" elif [ -n "${docker_image}" ]; then /bin/bash "${module_dir}/runner_docker.sh" "${docker_image}" "${task_code}" else /bin/bash -c "${task_code}" fi
